title: fix(lodash): use lodash v4, reduce build size

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @Jerskouille, @bobylito and @pixelastic to be potential reviewers

LGTM 👍 

How did you reduce the build size?

> How did you reduce the build size?

Since we were using lodash v3 and helper used lodash v4, we had two different versions living in the build. Now there's only lodash v4
